note: Pre-registered inputs for the 12 Nov evidence folder (LIN-4427). Committed before the freeze and before any fit. Each value is read through need() in analyse.mjs; a missing rule throws. The reasons for each rule are in the README beside this file. as_of is not written here: it is manifest.freeze_finished_at, and this file is not amended after the freeze (the manifest stores its sha256).

exact.lineages: every lineage has non-null dispatches, and no lineage is incomplete
exact.landed: production or test lines in either repository (shape code)
exact.dispatch_cost_with_zero_requests: a dispatch that made no request (requests 0, costUsd null) costs 0 USD; the lineage sum already counts it as 0 (LIN-4200: the dispatch 3e49cc95 is 0 and the lineage's 4.876455 equals the sum of its other dispatches)

size.primary: production lines (added + deleted) over the ticket's merged PRs in both repositories: LinearViewer census production rule (coherence-census.mjs prodAdded + prodDeleted) and simple-dispatcher code rule (size-prs-repo-neutral.mjs codeAdded + codeDeleted). Test and doc files are not in the primary.
size.sensitivity: production plus test lines in both repositories, minus the lines of test files whose basename matches the glob *.golden.* (size-golden-glob.mjs). The census's isGolden rule (any test path containing 'golden') is NOT used: the ask names *.golden.*, and the two rules differ on this window's files (e.g. tests/unit/render-session-golden.test.js is isGolden and not *.golden.*).
size.zero_size: a ticket with zero primary size is counted in the dropped count and not plotted

marker.rule: a ticket's repository marker is the repository with more primary production lines; a tie goes to LinearViewer

tokens.formula: inputTokens + outputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens, summed over a leg's dispatch rows (null if any row's tokens are null)
tokens.reason: price-free: /cost dollars are priced at read time, and LIN-4358's time-of-day tiers put a calendar term in them. cacheCreation1hInputTokens is already inside cacheCreationInputTokens (lib/model-pricing.js:48-51) and is not added again. Cache reads dominate some builds, so the token fit is reported beside the dollar fit, not instead of it.

fit.model: OLS of log10(USD or tokens) on log10(size), per leg (floor, work, keep-alive, Survey)
fit.min_n_reason: the existing coefficient rule (analyse.mjs: no coefficient below n = 8), set before any slope is seen
fit.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over tickets, with replacement

bootstrap.provenance: Tommy Ettinger's mulberry32 (public domain); the same algorithm as scripts/survey-landing-accretion.mjs:65 and test-surplus-scripts/sites.mjs, restated in fit.mjs

fit.reading: interval includes 1: straight line; interval entirely below 1: flattens; entirely above 1: bends up

strata.cohort_rule: first dispatch row of the ticket at or after cohort_from (UTC)

sensitivity.custom_to_keepalive: every custom dispatch that is not an after-answer is put in keep-alive (orchestration) instead of its lineage's leg; the tickets whose legs move are listed

rounds.regressor: round trips summed over both pairs; floor on log10(size) with and without it
rounds.power_note: 100 of 127 tickets have one review pass and 16 have plan-review (research); a null does not show no effect
